+#ifndef __PACKET_GENEVE_H__
+#define __PACKET_GENEVE_H__
+
+/* This is used by custom dissectors and should be in the "install" target */
+/* PUBLIC_HEADER */
+
+typedef struct geneve_option
+{
+    uint16_t    opt_class;
+    uint8_t     opt_type;
+    uint8_t     opt_len;
+    char        *critical;
+    uint8_t     flags;
+} geneve_option_t;

+#endif /* __PACKET_GENEVE_H__ */
